messages:
pagerbot: :rotating_light: Pager — SEV2: spike in gateway 5xx/504s for api-prod-west (started ~1728999990). Alerts show 504s + elevated downstream retries. Paging oncall.
meera: i'm on it, jumping in. timeline? any customer-facing errors reported yet? :eyes:
alex: seeing a burst of 504s from gateway -> upstream pool (model-runtime). Traffic normal, but retry rate upstream spiked. Customers reporting timeouts in logs.
sam: attaching a quick aggregated timeline from our tracer: correlation ids with high latency
alex: paste of a few correlation ids for triage: cid=abc123, cid=def456, cid=ghi789
irene: adding kvlog bundle to thread. quick grep shows repeated upstream 429/503 then gateway 504 after retries. hypothesis: retry amplification + upstream queueing.
meera: can we get a raw request log sample? alex, can you share `kubectl` snippet you ran?
alex: command i used:
```
kubectl logs -l app=gateway -c gateway --since=10m | grep "correlation":"abc123" -A 20
```
alex: sample log block (sanitized):
```
INFO gateway request id=abc123 path=/v1/generate latency=1200ms upstream_status=503 upstream_try=1
WARN gateway request id=abc123 path=/v1/generate latency=2400ms upstream_status=503 upstream_try=2
ERROR gateway request id=abc123 path=/v1/generate latency=3600ms final_status=504
```
sam: that's classic retry pile-up. upstream service returning 503s -> gateway retries -> fills upstream queue -> tail latency spikes -> gateway returns 504s.
ops-bot: runbook note: if retries amplify, flip down client-side retries or enable circuit breaker. Exec options:
- reduce gateway retry count to 1
- enable circuit-breaker on runtime pool
- scale runtime pool by +2 nodes (temporary)
- route to fallback model variant (lower latency) for p95-critical routes
meera: quick mitigation plan: 1) disable gateway retries for api-prod-west (temporary) 2) scale runtime pool +2 3) enable canary fallback route for non-critical customers
irene: i'm ok to flip retries -> setting now. @alex can you confirm there's no immediate risk to acked in-flight jobs?
alex: in-flight will see some failures but better than systemic tail latency. i'm toggling retries flag: `PATCH /config/retries?env=prod-west` -> `retries=0`
sam: scaling runtime pool now: `orchctl scale runtime-pool/model-runtime-prod-west +2` (kickoff)
meera: putting a short customer notice on status page and DMing SRE for SLA impact calc. also logging all correlation ids for post-incident RCA.
pagerbot: Pager update: mitigations applied (retries disabled, +2 nodes scaling requested). Error rate dropping :thumbsup: monitoring p95.
alex: monitoring shows 504 rate decreased from 7% -> 1.2% in last 3m. p95 latency improving.
irene: saving timeline + kvlog to /incident-bundles/1729000123.tar.gz. included correlation ids and full traces.
sam: hypothesis to track in RCA: 1) aggressive client-side retry policy + transient upstream rate-limit caused retry amplification 2) runtime admission control/backpressure insufficient 3) deployment/rolling update coincidentally reduced headroom in pool
meera: asking product/CS: any high-priority customers impacted? if yes we escalate to SEV1. I'm pinging @customer-success.
meera: next steps for in-thread RCA coordination: - collect complete list of affected correlation ids - check upstream (model-runtime) logs for GC/oom/restart events - evaluate retry config history (when changed) - run synthetic traffic to validate fixes
alex: logs show no OOMs or restarts for runtime during window. GC spikes slight but not correlated.
ops-bot: note: there was a config roll earlier today that increased default retries from 1 -> 3 for experimental routing. config change id: cfg-2024-11-07-77
meera: okay that aligns. mark config change as hypothesis contributor. we'll include in RCA timeline.
irene: drafting immediate RCA notes: short summary, timeline, mitigation steps, and a list of hypotheses. i'll post an initial RCA draft to #postmortems in 1h.
sam: retaining all traces and KV logs. flagged tickets for follow-ups: - add circuit-breaker on runtime pool - make retry policy per-route configurable - add synthetic canary traffic to detect capacity loss earlier
meera: thanks team. staying in thread for any follow-ups. please add any correlation ids you find and tag with reason (mitigation, customer-impact, repro).
alex: found two more cids: cid=jkl012 cid=mno345 (added to bundle)
meera: closing active mitigation now that p95 stable < SLA threshold. keeping thread open for RCA collection. :raising_hand:
pagerbot: :white_check_mark: Incident resolved for alerts. Monitoring will continue for 1h."
